Title: 503245-2026: France – Architectural and engineering services and related planning services – Design competition for project management for the deconstruction and reconstruction of the Jules Vallès wing on the campus in Brive la Gaillarde (19) of the Université de Limoges.
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: The project concerns the new construction/reconstruction of a campus building, which is generally of interest for sbp (university campus). As it is located in France and there are no indications of large or complex structural engineering tasks, the relevance is only moderate.
titel: Competition for the planning of the deconstruction and new construction of the Jules Vallès wing on the Brive campus of the Université de Limoges
kurzbeschreibung: The Université de Limoges has held a restricted planning competition for the deconstruction and new construction of the obsolete and no longer suitable Aile Jules Vallès on the campus in Brive-la-Gaillarde. The competition aims at a new building with teaching and service areas as well as staff housing; the contract was awarded to AMC2 Architectes.
wettbewerb_art: Restricted architectural and engineering competition (Concours de maîtrise d’œuvre)
gewinner_kontakt: AMC2 Architectes, 13 avenue Joseph Clausat, 63400 Chamalières, France; E-mail: amc2architectes@gmail.com; Contract value: -
projektbeteiligte:
Client: Université de Limoges (public-law institution), 33 rue François Mitterrand, 87000 Limoges, France, E-mail: service.marches@unilim.fr
Competition winner / bidder: AMC2 Architectes (architect / Maîtrise d’œuvre), 13 avenue Joseph Clausat, 63400 Chamalières, France, E-mail: amc2architectes@gmail.com
relevanzbewertung_begruendung:
- University building construction, but presumably on a rather conventional scale with no indications of special structural complexity
- Project is located outside the DACH region and does not involve bridges or long-span roof structures
- Competition already includes the Maîtrise d’œuvre, structural design is likely integrated within the general planner team
checking_engineer_begruendung:
- France, therefore no classic German checking engineer procedure
- No indication of exceptionally large or complex structures for which an independent checking engineer mandate would likely be awarded internationally
- Medium-sized university building, more of a standard building project
baukosten_erklaerung: No information on construction costs in the TED text; due to the lack of area data, a reliable estimate is not possible.
naechste_schritte: No active steps recommended. Record the project for monitoring of university buildings in France, but do not prioritize targeted contact with AMC2 Architectes or evaluation for the checking engineer team.
notes: Competition result for a Maîtrise d’œuvre competition (planning services) for the deconstruction and reconstruction of a wing (Aile Jules Vallès) on the Brive campus of the Université de Limoges. Winner AMC2 Architectes (SME) was selected on 23.06.2026. Structural design has presumably already been awarded as part of the Maîtrise d’œuvre; no indications of bridges, long-span roofs, or special structures.
